title: 0:00–0:20 · Set up in two taps
lede: Voiceover: “Indians hold 3 to 4 cards and still guess at checkout. cc-smith answers in rupees, from the bank's own words. Setup: with a one-time code we fetch your cards from the credit bureau, each named exactly with its fee, and build your budget from last month's card SMS and email — both simulated for this demo.”
